# Connection status (`connection-status`)

Connected, reconnecting with a retry countdown, and offline states for a screen that talks to a home server.

Group: Home controls. Styles: `import '@mosaic-home/design-system/css/home';` (or `style.css`).

## Web API

`createConnectionStatus` (types in `dist/web/home/security/connectionStatus.d.ts`): `.mh-connection-status` (`--<state>`, `--banner`): an `__icon`, `__text` with the `__state` (a `role="status"` region, so changes are announced, the ticking countdown not) and the `__detail` line (the retry countdown, a given detail or the server's name), and a "Retry now" `__retry` button while not connected. States `.is-busy` (connecting, the icon pulses unless motion is reduced) and `.is-quiet` (connected with `quietWhenConnected`: a dot only).

```ts
export function createConnectionStatus(options: ConnectionStatusOptions): ConnectionStatusHandle;

export interface ConnectionStatusOptions {
  state: ConnectionState;
  /** The server's name or address ("homeassistant.local"), shown after the state. */
  server?: string | null;
  /** When the next attempt starts, in epoch milliseconds: a countdown. */
  retryAt?: number | null;
  /** Replaces the second line (for example "Check the access token in Settings"). */
  detail?: string | null;
  /** `pill` (default) sits in a corner; `banner` spans the top of a screen. */
  variant?: ConnectionStatusVariant;
  /** While connected, only a small dot (named for screen readers). */
  quietWhenConnected?: boolean;
  labels?: ConnectionStatusLabelsInput;
  /** Offers "Retry now" while not connected. */
  onRetry?: () => void;
}

export interface ConnectionStatusHandle {
  el: HTMLDivElement;
  update(changes: Partial<ConnectionStatusOptions>): void;
  /** Stops the countdown timer. */
  destroy(): void;
}
```

## Web example

```ts
import { createConnectionStatus } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/web';

const status = createConnectionStatus({
  state: 'connecting',
  server: 'homeassistant.local',
  variant: 'banner',
  onRetry: () => connect(),
});

let retry: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | undefined;

function connect(): void {
  clearTimeout(retry);
  status.update({ state: 'connecting', retryAt: null });
  const socket = new WebSocket('ws://homeassistant.local:8123/socket');
  socket.onopen = () => status.update({ state: 'connected' });
  socket.onclose = () => {
    status.update({ state: 'reconnecting', retryAt: Date.now() + 10_000 });
    retry = setTimeout(connect, 10_000);
  };
}

connect();
document.body.append(status.el);
```

## React example

```tsx
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { ConnectionStatus } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/react';
import type { ConnectionState } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/web';

export function ConnectionStatusExample() {
  const [state, setState] = useState<ConnectionState>('connecting');
  const [retryAt, setRetryAt] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const [attempt, setAttempt] = useState(0);

  useEffect(() => {
    let retry: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | undefined;
    const socket = new WebSocket('ws://homeassistant.local:8123/socket');
    socket.onopen = () => setState('connected');
    socket.onclose = () => {
      setState('reconnecting');
      setRetryAt(Date.now() + 10_000);
      retry = setTimeout(() => setAttempt((n) => n + 1), 10_000);
    };
    return () => {
      clearTimeout(retry);
      socket.onclose = null;
      socket.close();
    };
  }, [attempt]);

  const retryNow = () => {
    setState('connecting');
    setRetryAt(null);
    setAttempt((n) => n + 1);
  };
  return (
    <ConnectionStatus
      state={state}
      server="homeassistant.local"
      variant="banner"
      retryAt={retryAt}
      onRetry={retryNow}
    />
  );
}
```
